title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Handle CSV (comma-separated values) files
summary: This is an index post for a series of articles on handling CSV files in Business Central. It links to articles on importing and exporting table data as CSV, bulk importing long text through AL, using Power Automate for CSV import and export without customization, previewing files such as CSV inside BC, and the BC25 Copilot feature that suggests sales lines from a CSV file.
key_points: The post only lists links to separate articles and has no technical content of its own
Covered topics include importing CSV data into BC and exporting table data to CSV
Power Automate can export BC data to CSV (JSON to CSV) and import CSV into BC (CSV to JSON) without customization
Text longer than 250 or 2048 characters can be bulk imported from external files using AL
Since 2024 wave 2 (BC25), Copilot can suggest sales lines from a CSV file
